en.help_tooltip: This screen allows you to manage your warriors more effectively! You can give them a specific focus, which will provide some benefits (and possibly some negatives) to your Clan.  Some focuses are not available in classic mode.  Click on each focus to see a description of what they will do.  Focuses that target other Clans will allow you to choose which Clans you target.  Your focus can only be changed every 3 moons, so choose carefully.
en.what_to_focus: What should your warriors focus on?
en.no_deputy: Without a healthy deputy, the Clan has nobody to focus the warriors.
en.hunting_buff_hunter: The deputy's skill in hunting will help the warriors gather more prey.
en.hunting_buff_climber: The deputy's skill in climbing will help the warriors navigate the terrain to avoid injury.
en.hunting_buff_swimmer: The deputy's skill in swimming will help the warriors navigate the terrain to avoid injury.
en.hunting_buff_runner: The deputy's skill in running will help the warriors navigate the terrain to avoid injury.
en.herb_gathering_buff_sense: The deputy's sharp senses will help the warriors find more herbs.
en.herb_gathering_buff_clever: The deputy's clever mind will help the warrior's carry herbs more efficiently.
en.threaten_outsiders_buff_fighter: The deputy's skill in fighting will better intimidate the outsiders.
en.threaten_outsiders_buff_speaker: The deputy's skill in speaking will help the warriors better ward off outsiders.
en.seek_outsiders_buff_speaker: The deputy's skill in speaking will help the warriors convince outsiders of their sincerity.
en.seek_outsiders_buff_sense: The deputy's sharp senses will help the warriors find outsiders to speak with.
en.sabotage_other_clans_buff_stealth: The deputy's skill in sneaking will help the warriors better sabotage their enemies.
en.sabotage_other_clans_buff_mediator: The deputy's skill in mediating will help the warriors undermine their enemies.
en.aid_other_clans_buff_insightful: The deputy's insight will help the warriors find ways to aid their allies.
en.aid_other_clans_buff_mediator: The deputy's skill in mediating will help the warriors support their allies.
en.raid_other_clans_buff_fighter: The deputy's skill in fighting will reduce the injuries gained while raiding.
en.raid_other_clans_buff_stealth: The deputy's skill in sneaking will help the warriors steal more supplies.
en.hoarding_buff_camp: The deputy's skill in campkeeping will help the warriors store more supplies.
en.hoarding_buff_clever: The deputy's cleverness will help the warriors avoid injury and sickness.
en.rest_and_recover_buff_healer: The deputy's skill in healing will help prevent outbreaks of pests and illness.
en.rest_and_recover_buff_insightful: The deputy's insight will help warriors avoid injury.
